title: A_fact response
description: The one JSON object a model may return at call site A_fact. It is the machine-readable form of THE SHAPE and THE RULES in the ratified A_fact template; where the two could differ, the template is what the model was told and this is what the validator enforces, and they are meant to say the same thing.

claims.description: One entry for each field considered, whether supported or declined. Never empty: silence is what a declining claim is for.

claim.description: One field, supported with citations or declined with a statement. Never both and never neither.

field.description: A key copied character for character from allowed_vocabulary.

value.description: The value, as a JSON string. Never a number, a list, an object, true, false or null. Present only when the field is supported.

cited_span.description: Characters copied exactly from that item's value.

metadata_field_name.description: That item's address, character for character, when the evidence is a metadata field rather than text.

why_it_supports.description: One short sentence saying how that evidence carries that value. Required and never empty.

unknown.description: The field is declined. Present when declining and absent when not; never false and never null.

insufficiency_statement.description: One short sentence naming what was missing.
